Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122562918/
1 learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent State of Assam.

By this application under Section 438, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 [CrPC], the petitioners viz. [i] Sanjay Soren, [ii] Gobin Mardi and [iii] Phillimon Soren have approached this Court seeking the benefit of pre-arrest bail, apprehending their arrest, in connection with Gossaigaon Police Station Case no. 173/2023, registered for offences punishable under Sections 120[B]/341/376/511/325/354/509/384/506, Indian Penal Code [IPC].
3.

The First Information Report [FIR] was lodged on 16.04.2023 wherein the informant had implicated 3 [three] accused persons by their names and indicated their involvement with 7/8 others in the act of alleged torture on her on 15.04.2023.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are not named in the FIR and one of the suspected accused persons has already been granted interim protection by this Court by an order dated 14.06.2023 passed in A.B. no. 2097/2023.
It is further submitted that the petitioners are sought for merely on suspicion.

5. List the case on 22.11.2023 to enable the learned Additional Public Prosecutor to produce the concerned case diary.
6.
The petitioners shall not hamper with the investigation or tamper with the evidence of the case.

By this application under Section 438, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 [CrPC], the petitioners viz. 3.
The First Information Report [FIR] was lodged on 16.04.2023 wherein the informant had implicated 3 [three] accused persons by their names and indicated their involvement with 7/8 others in the act of alleged torture on her on 15.04.2023.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Having regard to the nature of allegations made in the FIR wherein the petitioners are not named; the projections made on behalf of the petitioners in the above manner; and considering the fact that one of the suspected accused persons has already been granted interim projection by this Court, it is provided, in the interim and till further consideration is made on the basis of the materials in the case diary to be produced, that in the event of arrest of the petitioners in connection with Gossaigaon Police Station Case no. 173/2023, they shall be Page No.# 3/3 released on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 30,000/- each with one local surety of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the conditions that :
1. The petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer of the case within a period of 10 [ten] days from today and shall cooperate with the investigation of the case;
2. The petitioners shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; and 3.
The petitioners shall not hamper with the investigation or tamper with the evidence of the case.
